name: THICK SKIN
blurb: +12 max HP both. Feelings bounce.

name: SECOND LUNGS
blurb: Steam regen +15%. Breathe like a brochure.

name: BANDAGE POCKET
blurb: Start a run with 1 Bandage. That's not enabling.

name: WARDROBE STATS
blurb: Gear HP bonus +4. Clothes are feelings with numbers.

name: IRON GUT
blurb: +8 max HP. Summit sandwiches count.

name: FARM PATIENCE
blurb: Tower falls chip 40% less. Crops can wait.

name: DISARM HABIT
blurb: Weapons drop 20% more. Sharing is caring.

name: POCKET SAND
blurb: Throws chip 8 extra. Also humiliating.

name: HEAVY WRIST
blurb: Charge-heavy 4 frames faster. Commit.

name: CLING CALLUS
blurb: Tower QTE window +60 ms. Tomb Raider called. We billed the ring.

name: LONG COMMUTE
blurb: Magnet radius +40. Insights come to you. That's not entitlement.

name: QUIET HANDS
blurb: Wanted climbs slower. That's enabling. Do it anyway.

name: XP MAGNET
blurb: Insight gems fly to you from much further, and the pull doubles its growth every level of the night. Growth was never this lazy.

name: CROWN
blurb: SNAP window +40 ms. Timing is a love language.

name: NIGHT EYES
blurb: SNAP in shadow +12 damage. Huntdown seasoning.

name: PINBALL BRAIN
blurb: Account XP from tables +20%. Everything is a score. That's healthy.

name: SCHOOL PRIDE
blurb: Account XP +10% more. The milk carton still wants a quote.

name: GROUP RATE
blurb: Survive XP gems pay +2. The circle still hates you.

name: SUMMIT JOKE
blurb: Eat at 140 m: +12 gold. Peace is also a sink.

name: BIGGER HAND
blurb: The CARD VAULT lays out 12 cards instead of 9.

name: CARD SYNERGY
blurb: SYNERGY cards can come out of the vault once you own both halves.

name: CARD EVOLUTION
blurb: A vault card at LV 5 can EVOLVE into its legendary form.
